definitions.explanation: The act of aiming at a target, or the sighting device used to aim. Also used figuratively to mean targeting or focusing on something.

examples.japanese: {照準|しょうじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ターゲット→ターゲット：11036_taagetto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{照準|しょうじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定|さだ}めた→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: I set my sights on the next target.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{照準|しょうじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせた→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}した→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧。
examples.english: The government rolled out policies aimed at youth employment issues.

notes:
Originally a military/shooting term for aiming or sighting, now also used figuratively to mean targeting or focusing on a goal, issue, or objective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {照準|しょうじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to take aim, to target
- {照準|しょうじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定|さだ}める→定める：10448_sadameru⟧: to fix one's aim on
- {照準|しょうじゅん}{器|き}: sighting device, gunsight
- {照準|しょうじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧: to narrow one's aim

USAGE:
In figurative use, {照準|しょうじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ is very common in news and business writing to describe focusing efforts or policies on a particular issue. The literal military usage refers to aiming firearms or weapons.

ETYMOLOGY:
{照|しょう} (illuminate, shine on) + {準|じゅん} (standard, level) — the idea of aligning one's sight with the target.
